This is the independent critical review and final planning result. The following twelve custodian drafts were deterministically validated against Hypothesis schema v2. They are tentative suggestions. Prioritize marginal scientific value, independently assess the admitted five and all proposed candidates, and output the most defensible ranked portfolio. You can revise the draft details or withhold a slot where the review cannot justify it. Preserve each adopted stable family and hypothesis ID and use revision 1. Twelve new slots plus five admitted and three pending reservations is the upper goal. G@1 remains an older unapproved proposal outside the allocation if redundant with H. Document any deferral and gate in gaps. K’s comparable witness provenance has a high burden given E. Assess D vs Q, A vs R, I vs S, S vs T, H vs U, U vs V, and capacity at large tiers. V is provisionally 150 Sources. Use the stock matched contract and separate optional diagnostics. Source volumes are unverified assumptions. No legal outcomes, real facts, authoring or approval. Your rank and critique are independent of the custodian's draft.

EXACT OUTPUT JSON SHAPE (mandatory). Root schema_version integer 1. Root keys schema_version, portfolio_summary string, family_assessments array of exactly five objects A B C D F (family_id, assessment, overlap as strings), gaps array of objects (axes array of registered strings, finding string), proposals array of detailed hypothesis objects, stopping_criteria array of strings. Each hypothesis MUST use integer schema_version 2, including all one-condition files, and exact draft keys and primitive types. In particular design.invariants, design.negative_controls, design.genres_and_provenance, design.evidence_dependencies, design.shortcut_heuristics and design.success_criteria MUST each be JSON arrays of strings, even when only one string. Strings for these fields cause rejection. grounding.references MUST be array of full reference objects copied from the draft or supplied public reference list. grounding.assumptions, grounding.practitioner_unknowns, objective.secondary_axes and feasibility.risks_and_limits MUST be arrays. Preserve the draft shape exactly when revising content. Use a compact output. In documentary_complexity retain the string prefix '<integer> natural Sources' and in authoring_and_review_effort retain '<integer> working scientific sessions'. Give the root gaps concrete independent review verdicts and remaining uncertainties. No Markdown, no notes outside JSON.

All new revisions retain status proposed. Use at most about 550 words per hypothesis, with succinct populated fields. The only one-condition slots should have a descriptive or comparative question with no claimed stock matched control. The stock factory can only freeze a matched condition as one literal body edit or a pure Source-order change preserving the exact Source roster. # Benchmark v3 portfolio research scope

This custodian brief summarises the earlier v3 research specification and its
[packet protocol](../../docs/workflows/benchmark-v3-packets.md) for repeated
development planning. The initial specification defined three independent
Matter histories and eight conditions. A planning round may consider expansion
toward ten independent families. Keep conditions and observations separate
from Matter-family counts.

The benchmark asks whether a single full-context extraction recovers the
complete explicitly supported current Person/Trust graph at a dated meeting
cut-off, attaches the necessary passages to each critical edge, and withholds
named edges left open by the supplied file. Use six existing relationship
types, exact names and quotes, and the frozen v2 evidence policy and same-edge
sufficiency diagnostic. Unresolved questions are recorded by reviewers. The
extractor exposes only its graph and attached evidence for assessment.

Use wholly fictional text-readable Sources grounded in English and Welsh
document conventions. Put the ordinary meeting purpose and cut-off in the
adviser's file. Author documents from participant knowledge, derive the key
independently from the locked documents, audit in both directions, and require

documentary reconstruction. The v3 specification records 97.18% micro-F1
over 18 observations on 14 v2 conditions, a median of two Sources and 123.5
Source-body words, and an incomplete same-edge attachment for the v2 linked
target. A higher word count or lower score does not establish scientific value.
The [frozen v2 study design](https://github.com/alistairkung/private-client-graph/blob/c4a21e5f/benchmark_v2/README.md)
